Unified layout: pad0 at 0, left at 4, top at 8, width at 0xc, height at 0x10, pad14 to 0x28, children at 0x28, count at 0x2c, pad30 to 0x38, surf at 0x38, pad3c to 0x27c, slot at 0x27c, pad280 to 0x290, active at 0x290, pad294 to 0x3a0, tex at 0x3a0, alpha at 0x3a4, tail to 0x3cc. - 2026-11-06: Literal-pool finding (`.scratch/consolidation-2026-11-05/slot-2/infer/B-literal-pools.md`). The literal-pool method reproduced msx.c and net.c exactly and consecutively in both binaries (msx literals immediately precede net literals; msx.c path literal is last in the msx block, net.c path literal sits inside the net block). The method did not reproduce main.c, aemter.c or d2_windows.c as single units: main.c members 0x538d00 and 0x544c50 are about 0xbf50 apart in `.text` with 147 other literals' referencers between them, aemter members span a 624-literal gap, and d2_windows members are spread over 32 literal slots. Main.c, aemter.c and d2_windows.c are therefore explicitly marked as inferred and contradicted by pool evidence; their merged placement is not a native TU claim.

- 2026-11-09: The server gate's d3dx8 screening reported 3,618 GoldTL findings (rebrew 6.20.0 and 6.24.0) against the 28 recorded earlier; the cause was an upstream bug, not the tree. Evidence: finding `0x00503e80` (game row `gm_FindNextFilteredEntity`, `spiel.c`, 341 bytes) was reported as `CD3DXTechnique::Initialize`, but `rebrew binary asm show 0x503e80` shows game code (`mov eax,[0x90e094]`, `cmp [0x773d88],0x100`) where the library body opens with a call to `__EH_prolog`; all 3,618 rows are FUNCTION rows, none LIBRARY. In `src/rebrew/lib_match.py`, commit `e438e776` (2026-11-05, a performance rewrite) skipped the byte comparison in `match_bytes` and `match_leading_body` whenever every relocation offset lay inside the compared window, so any same-size body with at least half fixed bytes matched any library symbol. Fixed in the upstream checkout as commit `b98b4dd1` (local, not pushed): one helper compares bytes and tolerates a mismatch only at a relocation offset, with a regression test that fails on the old code (`tests/test_lib_match.py`, both functions, plus the masked-byte case); the upstream suite passes (14,685 passed, 56 skipped). With the fixed source on `PYTHONPATH`, `rebrew library match --lib references/dxsdk8/lib/d3dx8.lib --target Europa1400Gold_TL.exe` returns 28 findings (`.scratch/d3dx8-match-fixed.json`), the count the project docs already carried. The project still pins released 6.24.0, so the gate prints 3,618 until a release contains the fix. Decision owner: user.

- Change: `db/inventory-server.dll.json` goes from 646 to 621 entries. 13 original functions the discovery inventory split at an internal return or switch dispatch take their full extent (0x10003520, 0x100035c0, 0x1000ad40, 0x1000c710, 0x10010530, 0x100128f0, 0x10016460, 0x100179b0, 0x10017ab0, 0x10018130, 0x10018150, 0x10018200, 0x10019720), 12 it lacked or started on the nop alignment before them are admitted (0x1000d340, 0x1000d730, 0x1000d930, 0x1000e750, 0x1000e9c0, 0x1000f3a0, 0x1000f480, 0x1000f590, 0x1000fad0, 0x10010080, 0x10010140, 0x10016670), and 37 entries are retired: 27 interior pieces of those functions and 10 starts on the 1 or 2 nop bytes before an admitted function. None of the retired starts has a function metadata record.

- 2026-11-16: Pinned rebrew 6.49.0 (from 6.38.0). 6.49.0 hashes reached headers by content instead of size/mtime/inode/ctime and edits large single-file metadata stores one record at a time (blocker set on this 21 MB function store: 34 s -> 2 s), and its replicated metadata no longer round-trips whole documents through tomlkit. The header-hash change made the stored headers_hash of 15 type records stale once; each was rebound with type_metadata.bind_type using its recorded size, native size, extent, offsets and cflags (compiler sizeof/offsetof checks rerun), only where headers_hash was the sole changed input. Round 5 batch 10 (84 queued lane keeps) recorded on 6.49.0: both clients link, GATE: pass, lint 0/0 on all targets; GOLDTL 0x527540 and 0x5a86a0 gained aligned pairs (208 -> 213, 189 -> 228) and read STUB under the documented same-size below-60% byte rule. - 2026-11-16: Pinned rebrew 6.51.0 (from 6.49.0, through 6.50.0) and made SQLite the primary metadata read backend: `rebrew-project.toml` `[metadata]` sets `read_backends = ["sqlite", "toml"]` and `write_backends = ["sqlite", "toml"]`, so every write lands in both and the git-tracked TOML stores stay current. The database (`rebrew-metadata.sqlite3`, created by `rebrew metadata migrate sqlite`) and its lock file are gitignored; a clone without them reads TOML, and its first write populates SQLite (6.50.0 treats a SQLite replica holding no document as unavailable; before that, a fresh clone read every store as empty and its next write would have dropped all other records). 6.51.0 reuses the resolved replica view while its inputs are unchanged: `rebrew lint --all-targets` under replication went from over 10 minutes (stopped unfinished) to 48 s, Checked 5538 files: 5538 passed, 0 errors, 0 warnings on each target. Verified with the full gate (scripts/gate.sh) on 6.51.0. Decision owner: user.
